resources.string: Importing local animated WebP packs into Telegram is not supported yet. Telegram does not accept animated WebP; conversion to compliant TGS or VP9 WebM with transparency is required. Animated packs originally from Telegram can be opened using their original pack link.
No Telegram app supporting sticker pack import was found. Install or update Telegram and try again.
No app can open the Telegram sticker pack link. Install Telegram or a browser and try again.
Unable to open Telegram or grant access to the stickers. Please try again later.
The original Telegram sticker pack link is invalid.
This sticker pack is empty and cannot be added to Telegram.
Sticker %1$d is missing or unreadable. Import the original pack again.
Sticker %1$d has an invalid file size. Telegram static stickers must be nonempty and no larger than 512 KB.
Sticker %1$d does not meet Telegram requirements: PNG or static WebP, no larger than 512 × 512, with at least one side exactly 512 pixels.
Unable to prepare Telegram stickers. Check the sticker files and available device storage, then try again.
